DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-induced acute dystonia/parkinsonism secondary to risperidone, or akathisia.

The patient reports significant restlessness, fidgeting, and an inability to remain still, which are classic symptoms of akathisia, a common extrapyramidal side effect of risperidone. We need to confirm if these symptoms worsen when the medication dose is increased or if they improve with dose reduction or adding an anticholinergic.
